blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present FlowAct-R2, a framework for interactive humanoid video generation that combines continuous multimodal control with proactive agent planning. Our method consists of two coupled components. First, a Streaming Multimodal Reference Diffusion Transformer adapts the pretrained Seedance 2.0 Mini reference-to-video backbone to accept rolling action prompts, streaming audio, and dynamically updated image, audio, and video references. Video-driven rotary positional embeddings align reference chunks with the generation timeline, while reference-plus-image conditioning and partially noised historical motion frames preserve appearance and avoid accumulated drift. Second, a Proactive Interaction Agent separates pre-online planning from online scheduling and response: it prepares a persona, a long-horizon agenda, and reusable multimodal skills in advance, then autonomously schedules behaviors, responds to audience input, and handles interruptions during a live session. FlowAct-R2 supports real-time 720p generation and hour-scale streaming across entertainment streaming, live shopping, video chatting, and live vlogging.
blocks.zh: 我们提出FlowAct-R2,这是一个交互式人造视频生成的框架,将持续的多式联运与积极主动的代理规划结合起来。 我们的方法包括两个组合组件。 首先,一个流线式多式参考扩散变换器调整了预先训练过的种子2.0迷你参考到视频主干线,以接受滚动动作提示,流线式音频,以及动态更新的图像,音频和视频引用. 视频驱动的旋转位置嵌入使参考块与生成时间表一致,而参考加图像配置和部分噪声历史运动框则保持外观并避免累积漂移. 第二,主动互动代理将在线前规划与在线调度和响应区分开来:它事先准备一个人物,一个长视野的议程,以及可重复使用的多模式技能,然后自主地安排行为,响应观众输入,并在直播会中处理中断. 流动 Act-R2支持实时的720p生成和小时流量跨越娱乐流,直播购物,视频聊天,以及直播的vlogb.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Digital humans are emerging as practical tools for interactive applications, yet most existing systems remain confined to a single scenario, such as dialogue [ 5 , 21 , 4 , 16 ] , talent performance [ 20 , 18 ] , or live commerce and product demonstration [ 9 , 12 ] . To support open-ended live interaction, however, a digital human should go beyond a collection of task-specific generators and behave more like a real human streamer: it should maintain a coherent persona and long-term context, proactively organize what to do next [ 15 , 6 , 17 , 13 ] , respond to unexpected user input without abandoning the ongoing activity [ 11 , 3 ] , and coordinate speech, body motion, object interaction, and scene-level actions.
blocks.zh: 数码人类正在成为交互式应用的实用工具,然而大多数现有系统仍然局限于单一情景,如对话[5,21,4,16],人才表现[20,18],或现场商业和产品演示[9,12]. 然而,为了支持开放式的现场互动,数字化的人类应该超越任务特定生成器的集合,表现得更像一个真实的人流器:它应该保持一个连贯的人物和长期的背景,主动组织下一步要做的事情[15,6,17,13],在不放弃正在进行的活动[11,3]的情况下回应用户意想不到的输入,并协调语音,身体运动,物体互动,以及场景层面的行动.

blocks.en: This requires both a generator capable of continuously realizing changing multimodal behaviors and an agent responsible for planning, scheduling, interrupting, and resuming them throughout a long-running session. Recent systems have advanced continuous humanoid video generation, real-time audiovisual interaction, and interactive world simulation [ 14 , 2 , 8 ] , but two coupled challenges remain. The generator needs to incorporate dynamically changing image, audio, and video references while preserving identity and temporal continuity. Meanwhile, the agent needs to prepare complex activities in advance and make latency-sensitive decisions online, allowing unexpected user inputs to redirect ongoing behavior without disrupting the session.
blocks.zh: 这既需要能够不断实现不断变化的多式联运行为的生成者,也需要一个负责规划、安排、中断和在整个长期会议期间恢复行为的代理人。 最近的系统已经先进的连续人造视频生成、实时视听互动和交互式世界模拟[14、2、8],但两个共同的挑战依然存在。 生成器需要纳入动态变化的图像、音频和视频参考,同时保持身份和时间连续性。 同时,代理商需要提前准备复杂的活动,并在网上作出对耐久性敏感的决定,允许出乎意料的用户输入,在不干扰会话的情况下重新引导正在进行的行为.

blocks.en: To address these coupled challenges, we present FlowAct-R2, which pairs a streaming multimodal reference generator with a proactive interaction agent (Figure 1 ). This design provides three main capabilities:
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些相互关联的挑战,我们提出了FlowAct-R2,它将一个流式的多式联运参考生成器与主动互动代理机(图1)。 这种设计提供了三个主要能力:

blocks.en: • Streaming Multimodal Reference Generation. By extending diffusion forcing from chunkwise generation to streaming multimodal references, FlowAct-R2 enables real-time video generation with rolling prompts and multimodal references, including continuously updated images, audio, and video, and supports hour - level ultra - long video generation with 720p. • Proactive Interaction Agent. To enable digital humans to autonomously drive their behavior when no external input is present, while seamlessly responding when interactions arise, FlowAct-R2 introduce an agent workflow with pre-online planning and online scheduling and response, which supports persona-driven behaviors, interruption handling, and skill execution for autonomous live interactions. • Rich Behaviors Across Diverse Live Scenarios. FlowAct-R2 supports real-time text and audio interactions across four representative scenarios—video chatting, live shopping, entertainment streaming, and interactive gaming—generating not only conversational responses but also expressive behaviors and task-oriented actions beyond conventional question answering.
blocks.zh: • 简化多式联运参考资料生成程序。 FlowAct-R2通过将散射强制从块式生成推广到流传式多式联运参考文献,使实时视频生成具有滚动提示和多式联运参考文献,包括不断更新的图像、音频和视频,并支持小时-超时-长视频生成720p。 • 主动互动代理人。 为使数码人类在没有外部输入时自主地驱动他们的行为,同时在互动出现时无缝响应,FlowAct-R2引入了具有在线前规划和在线调度和响应的代理工作流程,该工作流程支持人驱动的行为,中断处理,以及自主直播互动的技能执行. • 丰富行为横跨各种生活情景。 流动 Act-R2支持在四种具有代表性的情景——视频聊天、现场购物、娱乐流和互动游戏——的实时文本和音频互动,不仅产生对话反应,而且还产生表达行为和超出常规问答的任务导向行动。

blocks.en: Streaming Multimodal Reference Generation. By extending diffusion forcing from chunkwise generation to streaming multimodal references, FlowAct-R2 enables real-time video generation with rolling prompts and multimodal references, including continuously updated images, audio, and video, and supports hour - level ultra - long video generation with 720p.
blocks.zh: 流转多式联运参考生成。 FlowAct-R2通过将散射强制从块式生成推广到流传式多式联运参考文献,使实时视频生成具有滚动提示和多式联运参考文献,包括不断更新的图像、音频和视频,并支持小时-超时-长视频生成720p。

blocks.en: Proactive Interaction Agent. To enable digital humans to autonomously drive their behavior when no external input is present, while seamlessly responding when interactions arise, FlowAct-R2 introduce an agent workflow with pre-online planning and online scheduling and response, which supports persona-driven behaviors, interruption handling, and skill execution for autonomous live interactions.
blocks.zh: 主动互动代理. 为使数码人类在没有外部输入时自主地驱动他们的行为,同时在互动出现时无缝响应,FlowAct-R2引入了具有在线前规划和在线调度和响应的代理工作流程,该工作流程支持人驱动的行为,中断处理,以及自主直播互动的技能执行.

blocks.en: Rich Behaviors Across Diverse Live Scenarios. FlowAct-R2 supports real-time text and audio interactions across four representative scenarios—video chatting, live shopping, entertainment streaming, and interactive gaming—generating not only conversational responses but also expressive behaviors and task-oriented actions beyond conventional question answering.
blocks.zh: 富人行为横跨多元生活情景. 流动 Act-R2支持在四种具有代表性的情景——视频聊天、现场购物、娱乐流和互动游戏——的实时文本和音频互动,不仅产生对话反应,而且还产生表达行为和超出常规问答的任务导向行动。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : FlowAct-R2 couples proactive interaction with streaming multimodal reference generation. Our demonstrations cover entertainment streaming, live shopping, live vlogging, and video chatting.
blocks.zh: 图1:流动情况 Act-R2情侣与流传式多式联运参考生成的主动互动. 我们的示威活动包括娱乐流畅、现场购物、现场博客和视频聊天。

blocks.en: 2 Method Overview
blocks.zh: 2 方法概览

blocks.en: FlowAct-R2 has two coupled components: a Streaming Multimodal Reference Diffusion Transformer (DiT) that produces video, and a Proactive Interaction Agent that determines the behavior and its schedule. DiTs provide the underlying Transformer-based diffusion architecture [ 7 ] . As shown in Figure 2 , offline preparation provides the persona, agenda, and skill assets. Online scheduling combines these resources with audience events and interaction history, then supplies changing conditions to the generator.
blocks.zh: FlowAct-R2有两个组合组件:一个是产生视频的流式多模式引用扩散变换器(DIT),另一个是决定行为及其时间表的主动互动代理. DiTs提供了基于变形器的基础扩散架构[7]. 如图2所示,离线准备提供人物、议程和技能资产。 在线调度将这些资源与观众事件和互动历史相结合,然后向生成者提供不断变化的条件.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : System overview. Offline planning organizes multimodal avatar assets into a persona, an agenda, and reusable skills. The online agent makes behavior and scheduling decisions using audience inputs and history. The resulting prompt, audio, and reference streams condition continuous video generation.
blocks.zh: 图2:系统概况。 离线规划将多式联运的虚拟资产组织成个人、议程和可重复使用的技能。 在线代理使用受众投入和历史来做出行为和时间安排决定. 由此产生的即时、音频和参考流,要求不断生成视频。

blocks.en: 2.1 Streaming Multimodal Reference Diffusion Transformer.
blocks.zh: 2.1 流式多式联运参考传播变换器。

blocks.en: The generator adapts the pretrained Seedance 2.0 Mini reference-to-video (R2V) backbone, retaining its reference preservation capability. Diffusion Forcing assigns independent noise levels to sequence tokens [ 1 ] . FlowAct-R2 uses this formulation for autoregressive streaming inference while preserving the backbone’s bidirectional spatiotemporal modeling. Conditioning also becomes a stream: action prompts, driving audio, and image, audio, or video references can be updated or switched as the session proceeds. This supports changes such as presenting a new product or invoking a reference-guided performance within an ongoing stream.
blocks.zh: 发电机改造了预训的种子2.0迷你参考到视频(R2V)主干线,保留其参考保存能力. 扩散福尔茨指定独立的噪声级别为序列符号[1]. 流动 Act-R2在保留骨干双向瞬间模型的同时,使用这种配方进行自旋流推论. 附加条件也成为流:动作提示,驱动音频,以及图像,音频,或视频引用等都可以随着会话进行更新或切换. 这支持一些改变,如在进行中流中呈现一种新产品或援引一种参考性能。

blocks.en: Rotary position embedding (RoPE) encodes positional relationships through rotations [ 10 ] . FlowAct-R2 uses a video-driven variant to align incoming reference chunks with the corresponding generation timeline. This provides temporal alignment when references arrive or change during generation. Explicitly trained reference-plus-image conditioning, denoted ( R + I ) ​ 2 ​ V (R+I)2V , anchors identity and appearance. The model additionally conditions on partially noised historical motion frames to improve robustness to imperfect generated histories and reduce error accumulation. Specialized audio-driven training supports synchronization of speech, lip movements, expressions, and head poses, while coarse-to-fine inference progressively restores visual details.
blocks.zh: 旋转位置嵌入(ROPE)通过旋转编码位置关系[10]. 流动 Act-R2使用视频驱动的变体,使收到的参考块与相应的生成时间表保持一致. 这在参考文献到来或生成过程中发生改变时提供了时间一致性。 明确训练的参考-加成像条件,表示(R+I)2V(R+I)2V,主锚身份和外观. 该模型还附加了部分点名的历史运动框架的条件,以改善不完善的历史的坚固性,减少误差积累。 专门的音频驱动训练支持语音,唇动,表达方式,和头部姿势的同步,而粗细的推论则逐渐恢复视觉细节.

blocks.en: 2.2 Proactive Interaction Agent.
blocks.zh: 2.2 主动互动代理人。

blocks.en: Proactive agent planning follows a two-stage design that moves long-horizon preparation outside the latency-sensitive interaction loop while retaining online responsiveness.
blocks.zh: 主动剂规划遵循两阶段设计,在保留在线响应的同时,将长视距制备移到耐久敏感互动循环之外.

blocks.en: 2.2.1 Offline planning.
blocks.zh: 2.2.1 离线规划。

blocks.en: The agent derives a persona from multimodal character assets, including text, images, audio, video, and manually prepared material. It organizes the session into a long-horizon agenda and compiles complex behaviors into reusable multimodal skills. The persona specifies how the character should behave, the agenda supplies activities to pursue, and the skills provide prepared resources for execution. This moves session organization and complex behavior preparation out of the immediate interaction loop.
blocks.zh: 代理人从包括文本、图像、音频、视频和手工制作的材料在内的多式联运字符资产中获取一个人。 它将会议组织成一个长范围的议程,并将复杂的行为汇编成可重复使用的多式联运技能。 人物a 具体说明了人物应如何行为,议程提供开展活动,技能提供准备用于执行的资源。 这个将会话组织和复杂的行为准备从即时交互循环中移出.

blocks.en: 2.2.2 Online scheduling and response.
blocks.zh: 2.2.2 在线时间安排和答复。

blocks.en: During a session, the agent combines the prepared agenda and skills with audience text or audio events and summarized interaction history. It makes a behavior decision about what to perform and a scheduling decision about when and how to perform it. Depending on the context, a behavior can be initiated, overlaid, deferred, interrupted, or resumed. This permits the avatar to continue agenda-driven activity without continuous prompting and to respond when an audience event arrives.
blocks.zh: 在一次会话中,代理将准备的议程和技能与观众的文字或音频事件相结合,并总结互动历史. 它做出行为决定 如何执行 以及何时如何执行 根据上下文的不同,一个行为可以发起,覆盖,推迟,中断,或者恢复. 这使得造型者能够在不持续催促的情况下继续开展议程驱动的活动,并在观众活动到来时作出反应。

blocks.en: The schedule is expressed through idle, listening, speaking, and skill-execution periods. These periods supply rolling prompts, audio, and multimodal reference updates to the DiT. Interaction history is updated as the session evolves, giving subsequent decisions access to prior context. The agent and generator therefore operate at complementary levels: the agent manages session behavior and timing, while the generator realizes those decisions as a continuous video stream.
blocks.zh: 时间安排通过闲暇、听话、演讲和技能执行时间来表达。 这些时期向 DiT 提供滚动提示、音频和多模式参考更新。 互动历史随着会话的发展而更新,使随后的决定进入先前的上下文。 因此,代理人和生成者在互补层面运作:代理人管理会话行为和时间,而生成者将这些决定作为连续的视频流实现.

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Streaming and application demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 3.1 流动和应用示威。

blocks.en:
FlowAct-R2 generates real-time 720p video. We demonstrate changing references and audience interaction in four settings. Entertainment streams combine audience conversation with singing, dancing, and other skills. Shopping streams show product presentation, item try-on, and transitions between product references. Video chats demonstrate listening and expressive turn-taking. Live vlogs combine scene changes with audience-driven branching. These examples illustrate how the same agent–generator interface supports both conversational and task-oriented behavior.
Figures 3 and 4 show selected frames from the demonstrations.
blocks.zh:
FlowAct-R2生成实时720p视频. 我们在四个场合展示了不断变化的参考资料和受众互动。 娱乐流将观众对话与唱歌,舞蹈,以及其他技能相结合. 购物流显示产品展示,项目尝试,以及产品参考文献之间的过渡. 视频聊天显示收听和表现的转折. 现场Vlog结合场景变化和观众驱动的分支. 这些例子说明同一个代理 - 生成器接口如何支持对话行为和面向任务的行为.
图3和图4显示演示中选定的框架。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Entertainment and live shopping results. (a) Selected poses and gestures during a dance performance. (b) A continuous presentation of one garment, including front-facing explanation, expressive gestures, and a rear-view demonstration. Each row contains eight full frames from one video in temporal order.
blocks.zh: 图3:娱乐与直播购物结果. (a) 舞蹈表演期间的姿势和手势。 (b) 不断展示一件衣服,包括前立面的解释、表情姿态和后视演示。 每行按时间顺序包含一个视频的8个全帧.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Video chatting and live vlogging results. (a) Facial expressions and gestures during a conversation. (b) Viewpoint and scene changes during an outdoor vlog. Each row contains eight full frames in temporal order. Reference-image insets and audience text in the vlogging frames are retained from the source video.
blocks.zh: 图4:视频聊天与直播网友结果. (a) 谈话时的表情和手势。 (b) 户外风景时的景点和场景变化。 每行按时间顺序包含8个全帧. Vlogb帧中的参考图像插图和观众文本保留在源视频中.

blocks.en: 3.2 Comparison with Vidu-S1.
blocks.zh: 3.2 与维都-S1的比较.

blocks.en: Vidu S1 supports real-time interactive video generation through spoken interaction [ 19 ] . In the human evaluation, FlowAct-R2 achieves GSB scores of +54.76% for video quality and +40.48% for real-time interaction against Vidu-S1. The accompanying comparison describes improvements in visual clarity, motion naturalness and expressiveness, action responsiveness, and the contextual appropriateness of dialogue.
blocks.zh: Vidu S1通过口语互动支持实时互动视频生成[19]. 在人类评价中,FlowAct-R2在视频质量上实现了GSB+54.76%的分数,在与Vidu-S1的实时互动上实现了+40.48%的分数. 随附的比较描述了视觉清晰度,运动自然性和表达性,动作响应性,以及对话的背景适宜性等方面的改进.

blocks.en: Figure 5 compares the two systems across both listening and response phases. While the audience is speaking, FlowAct-R2 produces continuous listening-state behavior through changes in gaze, head pose, and facial expression, whereas Vidu-S1 remains close to the same frontal pose, smile, and hand gesture. During the subsequent response, FlowAct-R2 continues with varied facial delivery. The comparison highlights the richer nonverbal behavior planned by FlowAct-R2 across conversational turns.
blocks.zh: 图5比较了两个系统在监听和反应阶段的情况。 而Vidu-S1依然与前方姿势、微笑和手势相近。 在随后的反应中,FlowAct-R2继续进行不同的面部投放. 比较凸显出FlowAct-R2计划跨对话回合的丰富非言语行为.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Behavior against Vidu-S1 during the same audience request and subsequent response. The first four columns show listening; the final four show speaking. FlowAct-R2 varies gaze, head pose, and facial response during listening, whereas Vidu-S1 maintains a nearly unchanged pose, smile, and hand gesture.
blocks.zh: 图5:同一观众请求及随后回应期间针对Vidu-S1的行为. 前四栏显示收听;最后四栏显示演讲. 流动 而Vidu-S1则保持几乎不变的姿势、微笑和手势。

blocks.en: 3.3 Qualitative comparison with Vidu-S2.
blocks.zh: 3.3 与Vidu-S2的定性比较.

blocks.en: Vidu-S2 supports streaming reference conditioning, allowing product images to be introduced or switched during an ongoing interactive video session [ 18 ] . Figure 6 compares outputs for the same product references. Across three successive products, FlowAct-R2 retains the red packaging layout, the green pouch’s subtle line pattern, and the shallow octagonal box. Vidu-S2 does not complete these reference switches cleanly: attributes from adjacent products remain and blend into the newly generated object, producing predominantly white packaging, a prominent branch graphic, and a tall polygonal tin. In the separate cylinder example, it replaces the pale patterned wrap with multicolored stripes. These cases reveal both object fusion during switching and reduced fidelity in packaging details and proportions. We also demonstrate text-triggered dancing in both systems and reference-video-driven dancing in FlowAct-R2.
blocks.zh: Vidu-S2支持流式参考配置,允许在一次正在进行的交互式视频会话中引入或切换产品图像[18]. 图6比较了同一产品参考的产出。 FlowAct-R2保留了红色包装布局、绿色邮袋的细微线状图案和浅八边形箱。 Vidu-S2没有干净地完成这些参考开关:来自相邻产品的属性依然存在并混入了新生成的物体,产生了以白色为主的包装,突出的分支图形,以及高大的多边形锡. 在单独的圆柱形实例中,它用多彩条纹取代了苍白的图案包装. 这些案例揭示了在切换过程中的物体聚变,以及包装细节和比例中的忠诚度降低。 我们还在FlowAct-R2中展示了两套系统中的文本触发舞蹈和参考视频驱动的舞蹈。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Product-reference fidelity against Vidu-S2. Columns 1–3 follow successive product references in one paired shopping demonstration; column 4 shows a separate cylinder case. Reference images are copied from the source-video insets. Presenter crops expose differences in package graphics and shape.
blocks.zh: 图6:产品参考忠于Vidu-S2. 第1至3栏在一对购物演示中连续引用产品;第4栏显示单独的圆柱形案例。 参考图像从源视频集复制. 呈现者庄稼暴露了包图形和形状的差异.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: FlowAct-R2 advances live digital humans along three dimensions. First, streaming multimodal reference generation accepts rolling prompts and dynamically updated image, audio, and video references for continuous real-time video synthesis. Second, the proactive interaction agent separates offline preparation of personas, agendas, and skills from online behavior scheduling, enabling autonomous activity while responding to user input and interruptions. Third, the unified system supports both expressive and task-oriented behaviors across video chatting, live shopping, entertainment streaming, and live vlogging. Together, these capabilities move digital humans beyond reactive talking avatars toward persistent visual agents that can plan and act through continuous video.
blocks.zh: FlowAct-R2沿着三个维度推进了数码人类的直播. 首先,流式多式联运参考生成接受滚动提示和动态更新的图像、音频和视频参考,用于连续实时视频合成。 第二,主动互动代理人将个人、议程和技能的离线准备与在线行为调度分开,在应对用户输入和中断的同时,允许自主活动。 三,统一系统既支持表达行为,又支持任务导向行为,跨越视频聊天,直播购物,娱乐流媒体,直播网游. 这些能力共同将数码人类 超越了被动的言语形象 转向持续的视觉特效 通过连续的视频进行规划和行动
